title: Trial Balance after 6000 GST invoices, 2000 purchase invoices, 120 credit notes, 5201 payments, 150 TDS entries, 6 payroll runs and 300 journals equals the independently summed figures for every account; debits equal credits
Customer and vendor balances (400 customers, 100 vendors) add up to the receivables and payables control accounts
Profit and Loss net profit equals income less expenses summed independently
GSTR-3B 3.1(a) output CGST, SGST and IGST for April to September equal the output GST summed from the invoices and credit notes
The GST ledger agrees with the GL in every month (no differences), and its September closing input credit equals the input GST summed from the purchase invoices
Payroll registers for 6 posted runs: gross less deductions equals net pay, and gross plus employer contributions equals the payroll expense in the GL
Each of these reports answers in under 10 seconds on the large company
evidence: trial balance 437 ms; receivables 660 ms; payables 265 ms; profit and loss 91 ms; GSTR-3B 2026-04 604 ms; GST ledger 2026-04 729 ms; GSTR-3B 2026-05 445 ms; GST ledger 2026-05 819 ms; GSTR-3B 2026-06 445 ms; GST ledger 2026-06 630 ms; GSTR-3B 2026-07 418 ms; GST ledger 2026-07 617 ms; GSTR-3B 2026-08 431 ms; GST ledger 2026-08 811 ms; GSTR-3B 2026-09 404 ms; GST ledger 2026-09 588 ms; payroll registers 28 ms
